entities.name: Inkling
entities.description: Small creatures made of ink magic, created as mascots by Silverquill students; living inky voids serving as helpers and pets.

entities.name: Silverquill College
entities.description: College of Strixhaven whose students create inklings.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Silverquill mages updated inklings.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Silverquill mages update inklings to resemble calligraphy and illuminated manuscripts.
events.quote: Silverquill mages updated the inklings so they were less reminiscent of glistening oil

relations.quote: Inklings are created as mascots by the Silverquill College students
